measurement_context: AC-powered desktop run: Windows confirmed AC power and Balanced power plan before starting; idle GPU preflight recorded separately. Rainbow Six was closed. Resident desktop apps remain; background activity is not isolated. GPU clocks and power limits were not changed. One full session, not an independent-session repeatability study. See results/rtx3060-ac-2026-10-13-host.json for before/after context.

settings.timing_boundary: Repeated Python dispatch on resident CUDA inputs; CUDA event span includes device idle gaps; synchronized wall includes host dispatch and final wait; no transfer, compilation, or power sampling in timing
settings.graph_timing_boundary: 100 calls captured per CUDA graph by default; event span per replay divided by calls, reducing host dispatch gaps. Same repeated resident inputs; not application end-to-end latency.
settings.execution_order: Cases and dtype order fixed; variant order shuffled per paired round using seed
